_note: Assumed prices for the budget gate (estimates BEFORE a call; `ledger reserve` compares them with the run cap). Deliberately on the high side. Re-check against the provider's pricing page before quoting totals. Last reviewed 2026-09-28.

elevenlabs.tts_basis: eleven_v3 billed ~1 credit/char at list; ~$0.30 per 1k credits on Creator/Pro top-ups. Measured on 2026-09-27: 9,001 chars -> 2,473 credits (0.27 credit/char), so real spend is usually ~4x lower.
elevenlabs.music_basis: Eleven Music compose / video-to-music: ~900 credits per minute (2026-09-27 V2M runs); fal lists elevenlabs/music v2.5 at $0.60/min, taken as the ceiling.

fal.seedance_tokens: width x height x seconds x 24 / 1024 (fal's published formula; with reference VIDEOS the rate is x0.6 and their duration is billed too)
fal.basis: fal pricing API for bytedance/seedance-2.5, read 2026-09-27 (pneuma _shared/seedance-video.mjs)

openrouter.basis: openai/gpt-image-2.5-* via OpenRouter Images API; assumed per image at 1024-1536 px

codex.basis: codex exec image_generation runs on the ChatGPT plan's quota (no per-call bill); recorded in the ledger at $0 so the calls are still counted
